description: S7 probe: chunk2::pipeline_enabled depends on the second handler answering in its first poll (inline execution). tests/test_conformance.py (test_worker_probe) runs both cases in assertion mode against beconf --executor worker and requires both to fail the wire assertion.

cases.name: pipeline_enabled_second_handler_pending_1ms
cases.source: probe for S7 (worker executor); derived from chunk2::pipeline_enabled
cases.notes: pipeline_enabled with the second reply delayed 1 ms (delay_ms), so the second handler is Pending at its first poll, as every handler is under --executor worker. The first response is flushed once the read buffer is empty (pipeline_flush), so the first read_once gets only the first response and the wire assertions of pipeline_enabled fail.

steps.data:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: example.domain

GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: example.domain
Connection: close

expect.starts_with:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-length: 12
date: Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT

Hello World
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-length: 12
connection: close
date: Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT

Hello World
